summary.en: The largest organ of the body, covering the whole external surface.
summary.zh: 人体最大的器官，覆盖整个体表。

detail.en: Adult skin covers about 1.5 to 2 m². It has the epidermis (keratinised stratified squamous epithelium), the dermis (papillary and reticular layers) and the underlying hypodermis. Appendages: hair, nails, sebaceous and sweat glands.
detail.zh: 成人皮肤面积约1.5~2 m²，由表皮（角化的复层扁平上皮）、真皮（乳头层和网织层）和皮下组织组成。附属器有毛发、指（趾）甲、皮脂腺和汗腺。

function.en: Barrier against water loss and pathogens, thermoregulation, sensation, vitamin D synthesis and UV protection.
function.zh: 屏障作用（防止水分丢失和病原体入侵），调节体温，感觉，合成维生素D，并防紫外线。

clinical.en: Melanoma is the most dangerous skin cancer; the ABCDE rule helps in screening.
clinical.zh: 黑色素瘤是最危险的皮肤癌，可用ABCDE法则筛查。
